records.title: E6: the marginals were not held fixed
records.summary: The permutation routine moves unequal-mass atoms. Only 16 of 1,296 constructions preserve the specified marginal weights. The advertised 2.12–18.07 fixed-marginal range is unsupported and is rejected. No replacement range is asserted.
records.basis: Unanticipated violation of a premise; not a claim that the old numerical replay falsifier fired.

records.title: E7B: the pools differ from the preregistration
records.summary: Calibration uses the all-nine shared pool instead of each judge’s own pool, changing one threshold from 0.95 to 1.00. Pair evaluation also uses the global intersection. The preregistration-conforming confirmation claim is rejected; the original HELD labels are historical outputs.
records.basis: The existing operating-point-rule mismatch falsifier is met; its fixed consequence is REJECT.
